Certi-orari, 340 U. S. 928, to the United States Court of Appeals for the Seventh Circuit. *913Per Curiam: The judgment is reversed. Great Atlantic & Pacific Tea Co. v. Supermarket Equipment Corp., 340 U. S. 147.
